- link "Skip to main content":
  - /url: "#legal-heading"
- banner:
  - link "Must Be Viral":
    - /url: /
- main:
  - heading "Advertising and AI disclosure" [level=1]
  - paragraph: This page says what Must Be Viral commits to about AI tools and the labelling of paid and synthetic content, and what it does not promise.
  - paragraph: Last changed 2026-10-02.
  - region "Who we are":
    - heading "Who we are" [level=2]
    - paragraph: ERLV INC, DBA Must Be Viral, in Houston, Texas. The street address is not yet published. Write to studio@mustbeviral.com or call 713-899-9346.
  - region "In the studio’s work":
    - heading "In the studio’s work" [level=2]
    - paragraph: AI tools may be used in editing and post-production. Which tools, and at which step, is not yet published. A person directs every shoot and approves every delivered asset.
    - paragraph: A delivered asset that contains synthetic or AI-generated imagery, voice or likeness will carry a visible disclosure on the asset or in its caption, plus the platform’s own AI-content label where the platform provides one.
  - region "Paid placements":
    - heading "Paid placements" [level=2]
    - paragraph: No paid placement runs today. When one does, in our account or in a client’s ad account, it will name the advertiser of record and carry the platform’s required ad label, and paid partnership and sponsored content will carry the platform’s paid-partnership tag.
  - region "Testimonials and portfolio":
    - heading "Testimonials and portfolio" [level=2]
    - paragraph: A testimonial carries its attribution and date and appears only with permission on file. No result is implied as typical.
    - paragraph: Today no client name, logo, quote or delivered clip appears on this site, because no written permission is on file.
  - region "On this site":
    - heading "On this site" [level=2]
    - paragraph: The film on the software page is an animation of designed interface frames. It shows no person, place or product.
    - paragraph: "This film was made with AI: stills from Seedream v5 pro and motion from Seedance 2.0, through Higgsfield, on October 2, 2026. The room is generated. It is not a real Houston location, our studio or our crew."
  - region "In the software":
    - heading "In the software" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Outputs produced by the software are agent-produced. The run’s model route, provider and cost are inspectable in its receipt. A generated image needs a user-editable description before it can be approved or exported.
    - paragraph: On mustbeviral.com today, no generation run can start.
  - region "What we do not promise":
    - heading "What we do not promise" [level=2]
    - paragraph: No promise of reach, views, followers, engagement or results, for a client or for ourselves.
  - region "The date":
    - heading "The date" [level=2]
    - paragraph: This page describes what Must Be Viral discloses as of 2026-10-02. The date above is when it last changed.
